description: Land Acquisition - Pamunuwa, Yatawatta D/S Division, Matale District, Arali, Walikamam West D/S Division, Jaffna District (Section 05)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific plots of land for public purposes (construction of Village Secretariat and other public purposes), including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), the core content focuses exclusively on land acquisition procedures and property details, making it a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
